description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jet.
When Jet dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hex Parasite and another creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Jet from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Jet enters, its first and second ability triggers, dealing damage to a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hex Parasite, adding {1}.
When Hex Parasite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B}, removing the -1/-1 counter from Jet.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
